meta.title: Torah sedarim of the Land-of-Israel triennial cycle (Masoretic seder divisions)
meta.source: Seder positions: "Miqra according to the Masorah" (MAM), ed. Seth (Avi) Kadish, Hebrew Wikisource, as parsed in bdenckla/MAM-basics, MAM-parsed/plus/A1-A5 JSON (commit 2a108647c4b17e587a00549eb9fa8de8958e0e3e, fetched 2026-11-16): the "סדר" parameter of the verse template. Division "accepted" = the seder numbers without marks (the division accepted in printed editions; 154 sedarim). Division "leningrad" = accepted + the starred sedarim that MAM notes attest in the Leningrad Codex (and Sefer HaHilufim), with Lev seder 19 at 23:9 and Num seder 17 at 19:1 as in the Leningrad Codex (167 sedarim, the count of the seder list at the end of the Torah in the codex). Gen 22:20 (Sefer HaHilufim only, not in the Leningrad Codex) is in neither division. Verse ranges: each seder runs to the verse before the next seder start (or to the end of the book), in the verse numbering of torah_mt.json.gz. Incipits: first three words of the Westminster Leningrad Codex text (vowels, no accents).

accepted.mam_note_he: יש כאן סדר לפי חלוקת הסדרים המקובלת בדפוסים. אין כאן סדר בכתי"ל ובספר החילופים אלא בתחילת הפרשה הקודמת "כִּֽי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ" (כג ט).
יש כאן סדר בחלוקה המקובלת, אמנם בכתי"ל ובספר החילופים הסדר מתחיל ב"זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה" (להלן בתחילת פרשת "חֻקת" [יט א].

Pesach.mishnah: Mishnah Megillah 3:5: on Pesach "the section of the appointed times in Torat Kohanim" (Leviticus 23)

Rosh Hashanah.mishnah: Mishnah Megillah 3:5: on Rosh Hashanah "In the seventh month, on the first day of the month" (Lev 23:24)

Yom Kippur.mishnah: Mishnah Megillah 3:5: on Yom Kippur "After the death" (Lev 16:1)

Sukkot I.mishnah: Mishnah Megillah 3:5: first festival day of Sukkot "the section of the appointed times in Torat Kohanim" (Leviticus 23)

Sukkot Chol HaMoed.mishnah: Mishnah Megillah 3:5: other days of the festival "the offerings of the festival" (Num 29)
